events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: The Stolen City

options.text: Tell the envoy to get out of your city.

events.text: [city] has fallen. Our soldiers march through the streets, securing the city in your name. In the chaos, an envoy from [rival] finds you. Although speaking with a practiced politeness, every word radiates with scorn. "The armies of [rival] had already laid claim to [city] before you arrived. The mighty [character] demands that you return the city to its rightful ruler to avoid any animosity between our great nations."

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: The Stolen City

options.text: Tell the envoy to get out of your city.

events.text: [city] has fallen to our forces. In the wake of our victory an enraged envoy from [rival] storms into the court. With spittle flying from his mouth he launches into a furious tirade. "How dare you? [city] belongs to [rival]! [character] demands that you return the city immediately or suffer the consequences!"

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: The Stolen City
events.text: After our conquest of [city] we have received a message from [rival] indicating that they had also been trying to take the city. Overall the tone is only slightly peeved. If anything, it seems that [character] is rather impressed with our speed and audacity.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: The Stolen City

options.text: Take this gift in response to your kind words.

events.text: An emissary has arrived from [rival]. He addresses you with a pleasant smile. “[character] sends his congratulations on your acquisition of [city] and wishes you all the best. He will perhaps visit [city] in the near future to observe how it flourishes under your rule.”
